ENTERPRISE ADVANTAGES

## Powering the IoT Connectivity Ecosystem with Custom PCBA Solutions

Specializing in the design and manufacture of communication-grade PCBA, networking motherboards, and
IoT controller boards, we combine decades of RF and embedded systems expertise with mature
manufacturing processes to solve complex networking and data transmission challenges — delivering
highly reliable, application-ready IoT hardware for partners worldwide.

[Technical R&D]

### Deep Technical Expertise & Full-Stack R&D

Our core engineering team brings decades of experience from industry leaders including Cisco,
Huawei, and ZTE. With end-to-end capabilities spanning RF design, embedded systems, and cloud
platform integration, we rapidly deliver custom solutions for even the most complex project
requirements.

[Quality System]

### Rigorous Quality Assurance & Reliability Validation

Every design undergoes testing against international standards, with full-process quality
traceability and predictive life-cycle analysis. This ensures stable, uninterrupted operation even
in the harshest environments while significantly reducing long-term maintenance costs.

[Flexible Manufacturing and Global Delivery]

### Flexible Manufacturing & Global Delivery

With deep expertise in wireless communications and IoT hardware, we specialize in customized PCBA
fabrication for a wide range of communication modules — from wireless bridges and gateways to
industrial IoT endpoints. We support flexible engagement models including OEM and ODM to match your
go-to-market strategy.

Driving innovation in connectivity hardware — powering the intelligent IoT transformation with
integrated communication PCBA services Supporting project-based engagements, long-term strategic
partnerships, and custom development programs
LIVE PROJECTS Multiple strategic programs currently in active delivery

### About Us

Professional PCBA & Wireless Communications Manufacturer

**One-Stop PCBA Manufacturing Services**: We're a manufacturer that specializes in PCBA and
electronics production — PCB fabrication, component sourcing, SMT assembly, DIP soldering,
functional testing, and final assembly, all under one roof. Our facility runs fully automated
high-speed lines with precision inspection gear and cleanroom-controlled workshops. We follow ISO
quality management systems and international environmental standards, with a QC process that covers
IQC, IPQC, FQC, and reliability testing to keep every batch consistent and reliable.

**Custom Wireless Communication Solutions**: We build custom wireless motherboard PCBA, Wi-Fi
modules, and mesh networking boards that support 2.4G/5.8G dual-band, Wi-Fi 6/7, MESH networking,
Qualcomm platforms, and OpenWrt customization. These are used in high-power NLOS transmission,
industrial roaming, vehicle/AGV systems, emergency response, IoT gateways, and other applications
where reliability is non-negotiable. We handle full OEM customization with complete transparency —
so overseas customers always know exactly where things stand. Here's what our typical OEM timeline
looks like, built around the things that matter most: speed, compliance, and control:

**1. Requirements Definition & Solution Alignment (1–3 business days)**
Our English-speaking engineering team sits down with you to go over specs, performance requirements,
mechanical details, compliance needs (CE, FCC, RoHS, etc.), and order volume. We then put together a
detailed proposal and quote so everyone's on the same page from day one.

# Bridge Operator Console: Communication Tools Built to Help Organizations Endure and Thrive

Bridge Operator Console helps organizations on Microsoft Teams, RingCentral, Dialpad, Skype for
Business, and Cisco CUCM build clearer, more resilient communications that adapt as their needs
evolve. Phone-first teams get the visibility and control to direct calls with calm precision and
human judgment — sustaining the connections that let organizations succeed over the long run, no
matter what the day or the future brings.

With full call control, Agentic AI, AI-powered predictive transfer, related people lookups,
integrated messaging, SMS, intercom, and more, Bridge Operator Console goes far beyond traditional
call handling.

The latest generation, included in our Cloud Suite, requires no installation -- making setup
seamless and instant. Runs in any modern web browser with no installation required. Features MS
presence, call queue visibility, cherry picking, parking lot visibility, and more.

* **1. Chat First Users**: Native App (Teams, RingCentral, Dialpad, Jabber, Skype)
* **2. Meeting First Users**: Native App (Teams, RingCentral, Dialpad, Jabber, Skype)
* **3. Phone First Users:** Bridge Operator Console

Phone-first users excel as communicators, gatekeepers, and problem-solvers, ensuring professional
and efficient call handling by directing calls to the right person or department.

# Digital publishing your way

##### Transform your documents into interactive content instantly and for free!

PERSONALIZATION

### Optimize the reading experience

Personalize your publications to match your visual identity. Add interactive features to bring your
content to life and share it effortlessly to captivate your audience.

[Learn more][23]
[Optimize the reading experience]
[Maximize your growth potential]
CONVERSION

### Maximize your growth potential

Transform every interaction into a conversion opportunity. Nurture relationships with new leads and
keep your pipeline filled with qualified prospects.

[Learn more][24]
STATISTICS

### Build a strategy on data

Analyze reading trends and audience preferences to improve your publications' performance. Gain
deeper audience insights and optimize your marketing efforts with precision.

[Learn more][25]
[Build a strategy on data]

### Explore even more features

Discover all of Calaméo’s features to elevate your content strategy and build lasting reader

### Smart, Safe and Connected

Extronics designs and manufacturers a range of hazardous area solutions for your **Wireless, Real
Time Location System (RTLS), Asset Management **and** Backup Power** needs.

Over 30 years’ experience supporting our customers around the world!


#### Wireless

Extronics offers a comprehensive range of wireless solutions to extend your wireless network into
hazardous areas. Our iWAP range of purpose-built wireless enclosures are certified to ATEX, IECEx
and MET standards, with flexible power and data options, proprietary RF isolation, and a range of
standard antennas. Extronics has the expertise to deliver cost-effective wireless solutions tailored
to your hazardous area requirements.

[Learn more about our wireless solutions][40]

[Extronics RTLS hazardous area location tags][Extronics RTLS hazardous area location tags]

#### RTLS

Locate your people and assets for improved efficiency, productivity and worker safety.

Extronics offers a range of RTLS solutions suitable for use in hazardous areas and harsh industrial
environments.

[Learn more about our RTLS solutions][41]

[UHF tags and readers fro hazardous areas][UHF tags and readers fro hazardous areas]

#### Auto ID

Manage your assets efficiently in hazardous areas with passive RFID (Radio Frequency Identification
Devices) and barcode scanners.

Extronics range of intrinsically safe UHF (Ultra High Frequency) and barcode scanning solutions
helps you extend your asset management directly into your hazardous areas.

[Learn more about out Auto ID solutions][42]

[Ex power solutions][Ex power solutions]

#### Power Solutions

Protect your critical components with Extronics hazardous area power solutions.

Uninterruptable power supplies, batteries and solar solutions specifically designed to be flexible
and meet your hazardous area power needs.

[Learn more about our power solutions][43]

### Where Ethereum Wins

Productive ETH Mechanics

### Every transaction will
### burn ETH, increasing Ethereum’s value

* ETH supply reduced, supporting scarcity and long-term value
* Strong economic alignment between Linea and Ethereum

### DeFi yield

delivering the best risk-adjusted return on capital, and fueling Linea's DeFi ecosystem.

### No Insiders,
### No Extraction,
### Just Ethereum

The LINEA token mirrors the ETH Genesis distribution.

Ecosystem Council

### Ethereum’s Largest Ecosystem Fund Managed by Trusted Stewards

The majority of the LINEA token supply will be directed toward builders, users, public goods, and

zkEVM Technology

### The Ethereum
### Equivalent L2

Linea is the only 100% proven zkEVM rollup committed to full Ethereum equivalence.
* Rapid settlement and ultra-low fees
* 10x ZK proving performance vs general zkVMs
* Compatible with the full Ethereum tooling and client stack
* Seamless evolution with Ethereum upgrades
* Jointly developed by Ethereum’s open-source community, including Consensys, ENS, and Status

Enterprise

### Enterprise-Grade Infrastructure for Global Finance

Linea leverages Consensys' decade long experience understanding and supporting sophisticated
financial instituions like Mastercard, Visa, JP Morgan, and multiple sovereign banks.
* Built for tokenization, payments, trading, and onchain settlement
* Seamless integration with major DeFi protocols, leading custodians, and tokenization platforms
* No DAO governance risk, ETH-aligned economics

## Our Story

### [Evolving with DJs since 1994]

For over 30 years, we've driven the evolution of DJ technology to expand creativity for artists
worldwide. Today, AlphaTheta draws on the DNA of Pioneer and Pioneer DJ, continuing our legacy of
innovation and engineering excellence.

In 1994, Pioneer launched the CDJ-500 – the world's first flat-top CD player with a turntable feel.
Combining digital precision with analog touch, it revolutionized DJing and marked the start of our
DJ business.

[1994][CDJ-500][145]

### [Defining the global club standard: CDJ & DJM series]

The CDJ and DJM series have defined the global club standard of DJ equipment for decades.In 2006,
the CDJ-1000MK3 achieved intuitive CD scratching through its exceptional jog wheel control, while
the DJM-800 introduced high-quality digital sound processing and more creative effects.Together,
they became the go-to setup for clubs around the world – shaping the experience of modern dance
music.

[CDJ-1000MK3][146]
[2006][DJM-800][147]

### [Expanding creative choices: DDJ & XDJ series]

As DJ culture evolved, so did we.In 2012, the DDJ-SX changed the game for controller DJs – combining
PC power and Serato software for a professional experience. In 2015, the XDJ-RX delivered
club-quality performance as a compact all-in-one device capable of playing tracks managed in
rekordbox directly from a USB drive.Both series continue to evolve – empowering DJs with new ways to
perform and express their creativity.

[2012][DDJ-SX][148]
[2015][XDJ-RX][149]

### [The next chapter: AlphaTheta]

In 2024, we launched our brand, AlphaTheta, to drive innovation.The rotary mixer, euphonia, delivers
an immersive sound that combines warmth and clarity, while the next-generation DJ player, the
CDJ-3000X, opens new horizons for professionals.From Pioneer to Pioneer DJ, and now to AlphaTheta,
our DNA of innovation and quality lives on.

We’re an electric cooperative that also delivers reliable fiber internet, phone, and propane
services to homes and businesses in rural communities in southern Michigan, northern Indiana, and
northwest Ohio.

## Smart Solutions for Rural Living
* [Electric][91]
  
  Member-owned, reliable electric services
  
  ##### Member-owned, reliable electric services
  
  MEC delivers dependable electric service designed for rural communities, with safety and
  reliability at the core. Like you, we live and work in rural southern Michigan, which means we
  understand the needs of people who live here. From smart outage response to personalized support,
  you’re never just a number with us.
  
  [ Learn About Electric Services ][92]
* [Fiber Internet][93]
  
  Fast, secure, reliable internet
  
  ##### Fast, secure, reliable internet
  
  MEC delivers high-speed fiber internet straight to your home, with no data caps, throttling, or
  hidden charges. MEC fiber includes Wi-Fi, parental controls, automatic hacker blocking, and
  network protection all at no additional charge. Plus, our local support team is just a call away
  when you need help.
  
  [ Learn About Fiber Services ][94]
* [Phone][95]
  
  Reliable home or business phone services
  
  
  ##### Reliable home or business phone services
  
  MEC phone service keeps you connected with clear, reliable voice quality—no dropped calls or poor
  signals. Enjoy affordable plans with unlimited local and long-distance calling, plus seamless
  integration with your existing internet service. Our local support team is here when you need
  help.
  
  [ Learn About Phone Services ][96]
* [Propane][97]
  
  Propane without the gimmicks
  
  ##### Propane without the gimmicks
  
  Our propane service makes life easier with features like autofill, tank monitoring, and consistent
  12-month pricing. You’ll never worry about running out—or being surprised by hidden fees and price
  increases . With local teams and a three-business-day delivery guarantee, comfort is always close
  by.
  
  
  [ Learn About Propane Services ][98]
* [Technology Center][99]
  
  Continuity and disaster recovery
  
  ##### Continuity and disaster recovery
  
  MEC's Technology Center provides secure, reliable colocation services with state-of-the-art
  infrastructure. Keep your data protected with redundant power, cooling, and top-tier security.
  
  [ Learn About Technology Center Services ][100]

# TRID

TRID is an integrated database that combines the records from TRB’s Transportation Research
Information Services ([TRIS][23]) Database and the OECD’s Joint Transport Research Centre’s
International Transport Research Documentation ([ITRD][24]) Database. TRID provides access to 1.5
million records of transportation research worldwide.

[ Video New TRID Video Tutorial Series is available! ][25]

This series includes short videos on starting your transportation research with TRID as well as
basic and advanced search techniques to get the most out of the database.

Due to licensing restrictions, the TRID database, or any portion thereof, may not be used to train
any Large Language Model (LLM).

electronics production — PCB fabrication, component sourcing, SMT assembly, DIP soldering,
functional testing, and final assembly, all under one roof. Our facility runs fully automated

quality management systems and international environmental standards, with a QC process that covers
IQC, IPQC, FQC, and reliability testing to keep every batch consistent and reliable.

### About Us

Professional PCBA & Wireless Communications Manufacturer

**One-Stop PCBA Manufacturing Services**: We're a manufacturer that specializes in PCBA and
electronics production — PCB fabrication, component sourcing, SMT assembly, DIP soldering,
functional testing, and final assembly, all under one roof. Our facility runs fully automated
high-speed lines with precision inspection gear and cleanroom-controlled workshops. We follow ISO
quality management systems and international environmental standards, with a QC process that covers
IQC, IPQC, FQC, and reliability testing to keep every batch consistent and reliable.

**Custom Wireless Communication Solutions**: We build custom wireless motherboard PCBA, Wi-Fi
modules, and mesh networking boards that support 2.4G/5.8G dual-band, Wi-Fi 6/7, MESH networking,
Qualcomm platforms, and OpenWrt customization. These are used in high-power NLOS transmission,
industrial roaming, vehicle/AGV systems, emergency response, IoT gateways, and other applications
where reliability is non-negotiable. We handle full OEM customization with complete transparency —
so overseas customers always know exactly where things stand. Here's what our typical OEM timeline
looks like, built around the things that matter most: speed, compliance, and control:

**1. Requirements Definition & Solution Alignment (1–3 business days)**
Our English-speaking engineering team sits down with you to go over specs, performance requirements,
mechanical details, compliance needs (CE, FCC, RoHS, etc.), and order volume. We then put together a
detailed proposal and quote so everyone's on the same page from day one.
**2. Sample Engineering & Validation (5–7 business days)**
We move fast on sample development and prototyping, and deliver test reports with performance,
compatibility, and reliability data. We'll go through as many revision cycles as it takes until the
samples match your requirements and get signed off.
**3. Pre-Production Preparation & Pilot Run (3–5 business days)**
Once the samples are approved, we start sourcing materials through our global supply chain (all
genuine parts, on schedule), set up the production line, and dial in the process parameters. A pilot
run of up to 500 units is then carried out to confirm process stability and product consistency
before we ramp up.
**4. Volume Production (7–20 business days, depending on order size)**
After the pilot run passes qualification, we kick off full-scale production on our automated lines
under ISO quality management. Every step is checked by dedicated QC staff and precision instruments.
We send daily production and test reports so you always have real-time visibility into progress and
quality.
**5. Final Inspection & Shipment (1–2 business days)**
Once production wraps up, we do a 100% final inspection and reliability test, issue certified test
reports, and get everything shipped through our global logistics network. All customs documents —
commercial invoices, packing lists, test certificates — are included to make international delivery
as smooth as possible.

# Bridge Operator Console: Communication Tools Built to Help Organizations Endure and Thrive

Bridge Operator Console helps organizations on Microsoft Teams, RingCentral, Dialpad, Skype for
Business, and Cisco CUCM build clearer, more resilient communications that adapt as their needs
evolve. Phone-first teams get the visibility and control to direct calls with calm precision and
human judgment — sustaining the connections that let organizations succeed over the long run, no
matter what the day or the future brings.

With full call control, Agentic AI, AI-powered predictive transfer, related people lookups,
integrated messaging, SMS, intercom, and more, Bridge Operator Console goes far beyond traditional
call handling.

The latest generation, included in our Cloud Suite, requires no installation -- making setup
seamless and instant. Runs in any modern web browser with no installation required. Features MS
presence, call queue visibility, cherry picking, parking lot visibility, and more.

#### Modern Workplace Users
* **1. Chat First Users**: Native App (Teams, RingCentral, Dialpad, Jabber, Skype)
* **2. Meeting First Users**: Native App (Teams, RingCentral, Dialpad, Jabber, Skype)
* **3. Phone First Users:** Bridge Operator Console

Phone-first users excel as communicators, gatekeepers, and problem-solvers, ensuring professional
and efficient call handling by directing calls to the right person or department.

## The Best ChainforETHCapital

### Where Ethereum Wins

Our mission goes beyond galactic scale. We’re also driving value back to Ethereum mainnet to make
ETH the most important digital asset in the world.

[Learn more][42]
Productive ETH Mechanics

### Every transaction will
### burn ETH, increasing Ethereum’s value
* 20% of fees burned
* ETH supply reduced, supporting scarcity and long-term value
* Strong economic alignment between Linea and Ethereum

Capital Efficiency

### Native staking on
### bridged ETH will fuel
### DeFi yield

Bridged ETH will be natively staked, and yield will be distributed to liquidity providers,
delivering the best risk-adjusted return on capital, and fueling Linea's DeFi ecosystem.

[tokenomics]
Tokenomics

### No Insiders,
### No Extraction,
### Just Ethereum

The LINEA token mirrors the ETH Genesis distribution.

[Learn more][43]
Ecosystem Council

### Ethereum’s Largest Ecosystem Fund Managed by Trusted Stewards

The majority of the LINEA token supply will be directed toward builders, users, public goods, and
Ethereum R&D—to be distributed by a consortium of Ethereum stewards.

[[consensys]][44][[ens]][45][[status]][46][[eigen]][47][[sharplink]][48]
[Learn more][49]
zkEVM Technology

### The Ethereum
### Equivalent L2

Linea is the only 100% proven zkEVM rollup committed to full Ethereum equivalence.
* Rapid settlement and ultra-low fees
* 10x ZK proving performance vs general zkVMs
* Compatible with the full Ethereum tooling and client stack
* Seamless evolution with Ethereum upgrades
* Jointly developed by Ethereum’s open-source community, including Consensys, ENS, and Status

[Start building][50]
Enterprise

### Enterprise-Grade Infrastructure for Global Finance

Linea leverages Consensys' decade long experience understanding and supporting sophisticated
financial instituions like Mastercard, Visa, JP Morgan, and multiple sovereign banks.
* Built for tokenization, payments, trading, and onchain settlement
* Seamless integration with major DeFi protocols, leading custodians, and tokenization platforms
* No DAO governance risk, ETH-aligned economics

## Our Story

### [Evolving with DJs since 1994]

For over 30 years, we've driven the evolution of DJ technology to expand creativity for artists
worldwide. Today, AlphaTheta draws on the DNA of Pioneer and Pioneer DJ, continuing our legacy of
innovation and engineering excellence.

In 1994, Pioneer launched the CDJ-500 – the world's first flat-top CD player with a turntable feel.
Combining digital precision with analog touch, it revolutionized DJing and marked the start of our
DJ business.

[1994][CDJ-500][145]

### [Defining the global club standard: CDJ & DJM series]

The CDJ and DJM series have defined the global club standard of DJ equipment for decades.In 2006,
the CDJ-1000MK3 achieved intuitive CD scratching through its exceptional jog wheel control, while
the DJM-800 introduced high-quality digital sound processing and more creative effects.Together,
they became the go-to setup for clubs around the world – shaping the experience of modern dance
music.

[CDJ-1000MK3][146]
[2006][DJM-800][147]

### [Expanding creative choices: DDJ & XDJ series]

As DJ culture evolved, so did we.In 2012, the DDJ-SX changed the game for controller DJs – combining
PC power and Serato software for a professional experience. In 2015, the XDJ-RX delivered
club-quality performance as a compact all-in-one device capable of playing tracks managed in
rekordbox directly from a USB drive.Both series continue to evolve – empowering DJs with new ways to
perform and express their creativity.

[2012][DDJ-SX][148]
[2015][XDJ-RX][149]

### [The next chapter: AlphaTheta]

In 2024, we launched our brand, AlphaTheta, to drive innovation.The rotary mixer, euphonia, delivers
an immersive sound that combines warmth and clarity, while the next-generation DJ player, the
CDJ-3000X, opens new horizons for professionals.From Pioneer to Pioneer DJ, and now to AlphaTheta,
our DNA of innovation and quality lives on.

[2024][euphonia][150]
[2025][CDJ-3000X][151]

  ##### Member-owned, reliable electric services

  network protection all at no additional charge. Plus, our local support team is just a call away
  when you need help.

# TRID

TRID is an integrated database that combines the records from TRB’s Transportation Research
Information Services ([TRIS][23]) Database and the OECD’s Joint Transport Research Centre’s
International Transport Research Documentation ([ITRD][24]) Database. TRID provides access to 1.5
million records of transportation research worldwide.

[ Video New TRID Video Tutorial Series is available! ][25]

This series includes short videos on starting your transportation research with TRID as well as
basic and advanced search techniques to get the most out of the database.

Due to licensing restrictions, the TRID database, or any portion thereof, may not be used to train
any Large Language Model (LLM).
